name: Lean Atlas
description: Extracts the Lean constant-dependency graph, classified into type (statement-level) and value (proof-level) edges — the authoritative source for the formal dependency relation. MIT. Added as a Lake require in the CONTENT repo's lakefile.toml (scope NyxFoundation, https://github.com/NyxFoundation/lean-atlas), not installed as a standalone binary, so `lake update` needs github.com egress. Export with `lake exe atlas graph-data --output graph.json --pretty`, then adapt to JSONL for `content/pipeline/lean-atlas-ingest.ts --ingest`. Requires Lean >= 4.17.0 (v4.28.0 tested); the folio image and CI now pin v4.24.0, matching qou. When unavailable, `lean-atlas-ingest.ts --scan` gives an approximate syntactic fallback and every consumer degrades to n/a rather than a false pass.
